title: Prove a uniform seven-call lower bound for three negative Q8 targets
body:
## Summary

Three negative-generator Q8 targets need at least seven positive i/j calls, with any finite restored dirty workspace. The direct construction takes nine, leaving exactly seven versus nine unresolved.

```text
arbitrary dirty workspace
  PR3517 scalar-core / call-Gram reduction
  complete exact-length 3 and 5 censuses
  no endpoint with fewer than 7 calls
```

This closes two explicit PR3517 handoff obligations. It does not decide seven calls, supply a physical caller or invoice, or change kappa/the selected frontier. The used PR3517 proof is retained unchanged with its exact origin commit/path/blob/SHA256; comparison sources remain separate.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3517 left exact lengths 3, 5 and 7 unresolved after bounded unknown solver probes.
  **After:** two complete implementations agree on every covered endpoint stream. All 64 diagonal-one Gram matrices at length 3 and 1,048,576 at length 5 are covered. The first-order equations leave 4 and 16,340 candidates respectively; all fail the full eight-coefficient target equation. The independent census tries every label list without the primary label pruning.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay passes: `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-short-negative-gram`. Both actual committed Git-free scientific/control commands pass. Controls cover 530 generic words, 5,222 target-rank valuations, eight direct nine-call words, 72 deleted calls and 320 faithful dirty columns; three optimized behavioral groups reject actual producer/action/enumerator faults and invalid inputs.
- Scoped Ruff and final-head `scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/q8-short-negative-gram --check-source-history` pass all 16 files. Export transport and before/after source/export identities agree. The package contains the proof, receipt, replay, exact sources and open next questions. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3517 for the scalar core and exact criterion, Tuafo/PR2900 and ywz65/PR2587 for the earlier reductions, and the retained Q8/register-model lineage. PR3471, PR3487 and PR3499 retain their finite-minimum, workspace and weighted-tariff results; PR3137 and PR3461 physical costs remain separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Isolated research package; frozen sources, shared code and selected-frontier records are unchanged.

**Blast Radius:** research

The mathematical claim is a computer-assisted short-length lower bound with a written uniform workspace reduction. Seven calls, physical admission, the complete multiplication theorem and new kappa remain unproved here.
